items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: And the independent band, which was the little Prince and Thomas, Thomas Leidenier. That's right. They played them.

ctx.x: Do you remember any parades, brass bands over there when you were a boy? Did they ever have a parade like they have them over here almost every Sunday in the summer, and funerals and everything? Did they ever have anything like that over there?

Oh yeah, they had them, but I can't remember. Back to that, I don't remember. Yeah, I know it was a long time ago. Yeah, the band was over there for them. And the independent band, which was the little Prince and Thomas, Thomas Leidenier. That's right. They played them.
They played parades or funerals too?
